siteDescription: An editorial guide to the Mornington Peninsula, rebuilt as a sharper cover page with weekly curation, featured stories, venue picks, and a clear newsletter invitation.

hero.title: The smarter way to open a Mornington Peninsula weekend.
hero.dek: Less brochure, more editorial cover. Peninsula Insider should feel like the front page of a publication that already knows where you should book first, where you should linger, and what is actually worth the drive.
hero.meta: Edited by Peninsula Insider · Updated for winter

featuredStory.title: The Peninsula in winter: quieter, sharper, worth it
featuredStory.dek: The crowds are gone and the Peninsula is showing a different face. Cellar doors with room to breathe, long lunches without a booking queue, and a coastline that finally feels like yours.

weekendPlanner.title: Mushroom foraging, new wave art, chocolate, and hot springs
weekendPlanner.dek: A weekend that earns the drive. One guided forage, one gallery closing soon, a final chocolate tasting session, and Sunday live music at the springs.

cards.title: Wild Mushroom Forage and Lunch with The Kitchen
cards.note: Guided foraging through Red Hill and Main Ridge forests. Cook-up with butter and herbs at the end. Maximum 15 spots. $85 per person.

cards.title: New Wave 26 at MPRG
cards.note: The Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery's annual contemporary survey closes 31 May. Catch it this weekend before it wraps.

cards.title: Rocky Road Festival Tasting Sessions at Flinders Chocolaterie
cards.note: The final tasting session of the Rocky Road Festival. Book ahead — it finishes this Sunday.

cards.title: Peninsula Hot Springs Sunday Sessions
cards.note: Live music included with bathing every Sunday. The best reason to book the springs over a weekend rather than a weekday.
